runtime: Go standard library (GOROOT/src); only runtime dispatch that the source does not show as a call on a parameter
conventions: Symbols are import path + qualified name (fmt.Println, encoding/json.Marshal, net/http.Handler.ServeHTTP). A func value is assignable only to func types or empty interfaces, so every non-top declared parameter type receiving a function is a function type.

entries.describe: SetFinalizer(obj, finalizer) calls the finalizer when obj becomes unreachable
entries.why: the parameter is typed any and the finalizer is run by the garbage collector's finalizer goroutine, not by a call in source

entries.describe: the print family calls Error(), String(), Format() or GoString() of arguments that have them
entries.why: arguments are typed ...any; the methods are reached by type assertion to fmt.Formatter/Stringer/error inside fmt, not by a call on the parameter

entries.describe: formatted printing calls Error(), String(), Format() or GoString() of the operands
entries.why: operands are typed ...any; the methods are reached by type assertion inside fmt, not by a call on the parameter

entries.describe: Fprintf(w, format, operands...) calls Error(), String(), Format() or GoString() of the operands
entries.why: operands are typed ...any; the methods are reached by type assertion inside fmt

entries.describe: Marshal(v) calls v.MarshalJSON() (else MarshalText()) of values that implement them
entries.why: v is typed any; the methods are found through reflection on the value's type

entries.describe: Unmarshal(data, v) calls UnmarshalJSON (else UnmarshalText) of the target
entries.why: v is typed any; the methods are found through reflection on the value's type
v is typed any; the methods are found through reflection on the value's type

entries.describe: errors.Is(err, target) calls Is and Unwrap of the error chain
entries.why: the optional methods are reached by type assertion, not declared on the parameter type

entries.describe: errors.As(err, target) calls As and Unwrap of the error chain
entries.why: the optional methods are reached by type assertion, not declared on the parameter type
the optional method is reached by type assertion

entries.describe: sort.Sort(data) calls data.Len, data.Less and data.Swap
entries.why: interface dispatch: the methods of the argument's dynamic type run, which a call on the parameter does not name

entries.describe: heap operations call Len, Less, Swap, Push and Pop of the heap argument
entries.why: interface dispatch: the methods of the argument's dynamic type run

io_send.describe: connect system call (net.Dial and net/http derive down to it); below it is assembly
starts a program (os.StartProcess and os/exec derive down to it); below it is the fork/exec system call
execve system call: replaces the process with a program

io_entry.describe: the net/http server calls ServeHTTP(w, r) of the server's handler for every request; r.URL.Path is the route key, r.Method the verb
accept system call: inbound connections of a server loop
recvfrom system call: a consumer receive loop reads messages here

route_patterns.describe: brace wildcard (net/http ServeMux patterns since Go 1.22)
ServeMux pattern with a leading method ("GET /items/{id}")

ffi_conventions.describe: cgo: a Go function preceded by //export name is callable from C as name
cgo: C.name calls the C function name declared in the import "C" preamble
the function is a wasm export named name
the function body is the wasm import module.name provided by the host

test_conventions.describe: go test runs Test*, Benchmark*, Fuzz* and Example* functions of *_test.go files

syntax_conventions.describe: protoc-gen-go-grpc generates New<Service>Client(conn); calls on the client it returns are the service's rpcs
protoc-gen-go-grpc generates Register<Service>Server(server, impl): the methods of impl's type implement the rpcs
a struct embedding the generated Unimplemented<Service>Server implements the service's rpcs with its methods
